size_band: Small (Rosario-based; staff reassigned to other Rosario firms)
the_problem: ArgenBTC, one of Argentina's first crypto exchanges (founded 2014), was squeezed out by the CNV's new regulation for virtual-asset providers, which asked for 140,000 UVA of net worth plus hard technical requirements, while international platforms were entering Argentina and adding competition for small exchanges.
the_decision: Founder and CEO Gabriel Vago said: "luego de varios meses de pensarlo, decidimos cerrar la compañía y elaboramos un plan lo más 'suave' posible de retiro de criptomonedas a los usuarios". His reason: "Es muy difícil para exchanges chicas cumplir con las nuevas exigencias de la CNV, como el requisito patrimonial".
the_outcome: Exchange wound down after 10+ years: withdrawals normal from 28 Oct 2024, buy/sell ended 11 Nov 2024, then withdrawal-only for at least 2 months; all employees reassigned to Rosario companies; DeFi and bill-payment features ended.
